sloka: मा च लक्ष्मण सम्तापम् कार्षीर्लक्ष्म्या विपर्यये ।राज्यम् वा वनवासो वा वनवासो महोदयः ॥२-२२-२९॥
transliteration: mā ca lakṣmaṇa samtāpam kārṣīrlakṣmyā viparyaye ।rājyam vā vanavāso vā vanavāso mahodayaḥ ॥2-22-29॥

translations.english: Do not grieve, O Lakshmana, over the loss of the kingdom. Living in exile is more glorious than running the kingdom.
